content: SIDI issiweř ak-d Ayub
Yarni yarra-dd SIDI x Ayub, inna:
Ma ixs wenni ittemcarraɛen ak-d Umzemmar x kuřci ad t iseggem? Ejj wenni ixsen ad idɛa Arebbi, ad dd-yarr!
Xenni yarra-dd Ayub x SIDI, inna:
Xzar, necc drus, min zemmareɣ ad xak dd-arreɣ? Necc ad ggeɣ afus inu x uqemmum inu.
Aqa ssiwřeɣ ict n twařa, maca war dd-ttarriɣ ɛad. twařa wiss tnayen war d as arenniɣ!
Xas uca yarni yarra-dd SIDI x Ayub zi tḥaryaḍt, inna:
Byes xenni tijɛinnatin nnec am weryaz. Necc xseɣ ad cek sseqsiɣ u cek, arr-dd xafi!
Ma texsed s tidett ad tarẓed řḥukm inu? Ma texsed ad ɣari dd-tarred řɛib, maḥend ad tbaned cek d amsegged?
Ma ɣarek aɣiř am Arebbi? Ma tzemmared ad teddardḥed am wajjaj s tmijja nnec?
Qqen xenni ixef nnec s lɛaḍama d uɛuǧi, arḍ s tissiqt d řɛezz.
Ejj aduqqez n ufugem nnec ad izeǧeɛ, xzar ɣar kuř bu nnfaxet, uca sehwa i-t!
Xzar mliḥ ɣar mkuř bu-nnfaxet, sehwa i-t, řbez iɛeffanen deg wemcan nsen.
Ffar i-ten marra am munen deg ucař, cfen iɣembab nsen di tnuffra sadu tammurt.
Xenni uřa d Necc ad cek ssemɣareɣ, minzi afus nnec afusi issenjem i cek.
Xzar maca Řweḥc, ‘Bᵉhimut’, wenni ggiɣ am mammec cek ggiɣ. Ittett arbiɛ am ufunas.
Xzar jjehd nnes di tejɛinnatin nnes, řɛezz nnes deg iẓewran nnes n uɛeddis!
Mařa ixs, ad igg akennas nnes am tcejjart n tengelt, iẓewran n tmeṣṣaḍin nnes meḥḍen mmuden.
Ixsan nnes tteggen am yiqudas n nnḥas, am barrat n wuzzař iḍaren d iɣaǧen nnes.
Netta d amezwaru n ibriden n Arebbi. Wenni t yeggin, iwca as ssif nnes.
Iwa, idurar ttawyen as-dd arbiɛ, marra řewḥuc n yeyyar ttiraren dinni.
Ibbuzzeř sadu i tcejjura itteggen tiři, deg udurri n uɣanim, di ssebxet.
Ad xas dduryent tcejjura i itticen tiři, kuř ict s tiři nnes, tinemrač n tɣezratin ttennḍent as-dd.
Xzar, mařa ihaj yeɣzar, war ittarjiji, ittɣima yarsa mařa řḥemřet n L’Urdun tudef as-dd ɣar uqemmum.
Ma izemmar bnadem ad t iṭṭef am ixezzar netta nican di tiṭṭawin nnes, ad as issnuqqeb tinzart s tesɣunin?
Ma tzemmared ad tjebded ‘Liviyatan’ s tsennart n weymar, niɣ ad tessehwid iřes nnes deg ufiřu n weymar?
Ma tzemmared ad as tegged taxadent n uɣanim di tenzart nnes, niɣ ad tessnuqqbed aɣesmir nnes s uɣanču?
Ma ad zzayek ittar aḥinni? Ma ad issiweř akidek s wawařen imiziḍen?
Ma ad yegg akidek řɛahd? Ma tzemmared ad t teksid d ismeɣ i řebda?
Ma tzemmared akides tᵉttirared am ak-d ijj n ujḍiḍ, niɣ ad t teqqned i teḥramin nnec?
Ma zemmaren ineymaren ad dayes sebbeben? Ma zemmaren ad t bḍan jar ayt n Kenɛan?
Ma tzemmared ad tejjud tiřmect nnes s fřitcat, niɣ s lansa n iseřman azeǧif nnes?
Sars xas afus nnec, xemm ɣar umenɣi, war t tteggid ɛemmarṣ ɛad.
